mapper.insert: insert into learning_points_watch (user_id, target_type, target_id, award_date, watched_seconds, awarded, points, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{awardDate}, #{seconds}, 0, 0, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update watched_seconds = watched_seconds + #{seconds}, update_time = sysdate()
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_post where post_id = #{postId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_course_video where video_id = #{videoId} and del_flag = '0'
